items.title: Virginia General and Special Elections
items.summary: Virginia's general and special elections are on November 3. Use the official election tools to confirm your registration and polling location.

items.title: Candidates on Norfolk's November 3 ballot
items.summary: Norfolk's Office of Elections publishes the official local-candidate list for the November 3 ballot. Open the list for the current contests and candidates; this app does not add unsourced race summaries.
